benchmarks.label: Full scores available · more native models running
benchmarks.summary: Teacher, quantized controls, eight-cell hybrid and the 8-FFN/50%-value native model have complete scores.
items: Full augmented EvalPlus tests: HumanEval+ 164 problems; MBPP+ 378 problems.

items: PrismML Appendix B.5.2: prompting mode (tools in the system prompt, is_fc_model=false, underscore_to_dot=false); macro-average of the 13 single-turn subsets; 3,641 cases; greedy, 4,096-token cap.
Withdrawn on 29 Sep 2026: function-calling scores published earlier that day under this name as a sample-weighted accuracy. They now have their own chart, “BFCL v3 · function-calling mode”.
In function-calling mode the local 1-bit and ternary Bonsai had scored 10.9 and 3.9 points above PrismML’s reports; in prompting mode they are within 2.1 points.
